goals.title: Safe laboratory
goals.objective: Implement Stage 0 and prove Gate 0 without changing the production wallpaper.
goals.failureReason: Fixture recovery verified with exact SHA-256/mode/mtime/xattr restoration; tampered bundle rejected without target change; live store read-only capture byte-identical. Full Gate 0 blocked because no disposable macOS user exists and creating one requires interactive administrator authentication (sudo_noninteractive=1). No wallpaper mutation performed.

goals.title: Compatibility contract
goals.objective: Implement Stage 1 and close Gate 1 with sanitized evidence.
goals.failureReason: Gate 1 remains fail-closed: the installed Wallspace extension and com.apple.wallpaper registration were observed, but WallpaperExtensionKit exists only in dyld runtime mappings and an SDK .tbd; no reviewed shared-cache extractor is installed, and both IDA MCP workers (installed binary and fresh arm64 slice) expose empty session IDs. Allowed XPC classes, request/reply schemas, snapshot/provider-selection contracts, and failure semantics therefore remain unknown. No wallpaper, extension registration, store, or UI state was mutated.

goals.title: Transactional activation
goals.objective: Implement Stage 4 only on the disposable account and prove Gate 4.

goals.title: System release gate
goals.objective: Implement Stage 6 and pass the release gate, including final cleanup and review.
